members.name: label
members.doc: Accessible name of the trailing button, for example "Copy link".

members.name: onClick
members.doc: Runs when the trailing button is pressed.

types.name: ExpandableControlProps
types.doc: An icon button or chip that opens in place: press it and it widens on a spring to show its label and, if given, a trailing action. Use it where a row of icons needs to name the one in use without spending the room for every label.

members.name: icon
members.doc: Always visible. Usually a 16 to 18 px icon.

members.name: label
members.doc: The text revealed when the control opens. Also its accessible name while only the icon shows.

members.name: onExpandedChange
members.doc: Runs when the control opens or closes.

members.name: action
members.doc: A second button revealed after the label, such as copy, clear or dismiss.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `button` is a round control at the standard control height; `chip` is the compact pill for tags and filters.

members.name: tone
members.doc: `accent` fills the control with the accent color while it is open.

members.name: detail
members.doc: Extra content shown after the label while open, such as a count.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Turns the control off: it is dimmed and ignores pointer and keyboard input.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class names for the root element.
